key.name: start-at-login
key.description: When false, Froonty waits after login with only a top bar icon; clicking it or pressing the toggle shortcut starts it. Screen unlocks keep the current state.

key.name: island-enabled
key.description: When false, the island and all its services are torn down while the extension stays enabled.

key.name: hide-panel-clock
key.description: Makes GNOME's top bar clock transparent so the island replaces it visually. The clock stays in place so its calendar menu keeps working.

key.name: hover-open-delay
key.summary: Open the island after hovering it this long (ms)
key.description: 0 turns opening on hover off; clicking always works.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to expand or collapse the island

key.name: hub-last-tab
key.description: The feature id shown when the island expands (see features/registry.js).

key.name: panic-buttons
key.description: At most 5 ids from panic/catalog.js; unknown ids are ignored.

key.name: notes-folder
key.description: Folder holding one Markdown file per note. Empty: ~/.local/share/froonty/notes.

key.name: notes-wrap
key.description: Off: lines stay on one line and the note scrolls horizontally.

key.name: notes-show-tools
key.summary: Show the formatting row in notes
key.description: Off: the row with the formatting buttons, line wrap and note colour is folded away (⤵ after "+" unfolds it), leaving more room for the note.

key.name: notes-width
key.description: In logical pixels, while the Notes tab is shown.

key.name: notes-height
key.description: In logical pixels, while the Notes tab is shown.

key.name: claude-enabled
key.description: Claude plan usage (session, weekly, weekly per model, cloud session credits) and when each resets, as Claude Code last checked it. Froonty reads Claude Code's config file and what its own Claude Code status line saved; it never signs in to Claude itself.

key.name: zerotier-enabled
key.description: Whether ZeroTier runs, starts with the computer and reaches its networks, and how each joined network is doing. Turned off on Froonty's first start when ZeroTier is not installed.

key.name: zerotier-install-checked
key.description: Set on Froonty's first start, once it has turned the ZeroTier tab off if ZeroTier is not installed, so that check is not repeated.

key.name: claude-ask-claude-code
key.summary: Ask Claude Code for fresh usage
key.description: When the Claude tab or its panic button comes on screen, run Claude Code's /usage (at most once a minute) so its usage cache is current. Off: only Froonty's Claude Code status line updates Session and Weekly. Froonty turns this off as Power Saver mode or a battery below 20% (on battery) begins, and back on as it ends if it was Froonty that turned it off; turning it on meanwhile is kept.

key.name: claude-ask-paused-for-power
key.summary: Internal: fresh usage turned off for low power
key.description: Set while Froonty has turned claude-ask-claude-code off for low power, so it turns it back on when low power ends.

key.name: claude-low-power-handled
key.summary: Internal: the current low power was acted on
key.description: Set from the start of a low-power stretch to its end, so turning claude-ask-claude-code back on during it is kept.

key.name: sysmon-enabled
key.description: CPU, graphics cards, memory, disks and network, read while the tab is on screen and not at all otherwise.

key.name: sysmon-interval
key.description: How often the Btop tab reads the machine while it is on screen.

key.name: sysmon-show-cpu
key.description: Model, clock, temperature and load; each thread in a fold-out.

key.name: sysmon-show-gpu
key.description: Each card's load, temperature, power and memory, as far as its driver reports them. NVIDIA cards are read with nvidia-smi, and never while asleep.

key.name: sysmon-show-disks
key.description: Root file system, swap and the EFI system partition.

key.name: sysmon-show-network
key.description: Download and upload speed and totals, over physical interfaces only.

key.name: sysmon-width
key.description: In logical pixels, while the Btop tab is shown. Below 460, each thread takes a row of its own.

key.name: sysmon-height
key.description: In logical pixels, while the Btop tab is shown.

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.summary: Show the Clipboard tab and record clipboard history
key.description: While on, Froonty keeps what you copy or cut (text, images, file and folder locations) in a history on this computer only (~/.local/share/froonty/clipboard, readable by you only), so it can be copied again. Passwords are never saved: copies marked secret by password managers, copies made while an app in clipboard-ignored-apps has the focus, and (clipboard-detect-passwords) text that looks like a password. Off by default.

key.name: clipboard-history-size
key.description: Older entries are deleted, with their images.

key.name: clipboard-ignored-apps
key.summary: Clipboard history: apps whose copies are never kept
key.description: Matched, ignoring case, against the focused app's desktop id and name, its window class and its Flatpak app id; "keepass" covers org.keepassxc.KeePassXC. Password managers and authenticators by default.

key.name: clipboard-password-minutes
key.summary: Clipboard history: minutes a copied password is shown, hidden
key.description: A copied password is never saved. The latest one is listed as •••••••• (in memory only) and can be copied again until these minutes pass, the clipboard is cleared or something else is copied, whichever comes first. 0: passwords are not listed at all.

key.name: clipboard-detect-passwords
key.summary: Clipboard history: treat text that looks like a password as one
key.description: Browsers' password managers do not mark their copies, so one word of 8-64 characters mixing at least three of lower case, upper case, digits and symbols (and not a link, path, date, hash or code name) is treated as a password: never saved, only shown hidden.

key.name: clipboard-width
key.description: In logical pixels, while the Clipboard tab is shown.

key.name: clipboard-height
key.description: In logical pixels, while the Clipboard tab is shown.

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show the date in the collapsed island

key.name: clock-format
key.description: "system" follows org.gnome.desktop.interface clock-format.

key.name: collapsed-width
key.description: Minimum. While the top bar clock is hidden, the pill grows to cover its button completely.

key.name: collapsed-height
key.description: Minimum. While the top bar clock is hidden, the pill grows to cover its button completely.

key.name: expanded-height
key.description: Minimum. The island grows to show every feature tab in its column.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Clamped to half the current island height.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: GNOME's global "enable-animations" and slow-down settings still apply.
